description: DDT 91 - Zones réglementées du plan de prévention du risque d'inondation (PPRI) de l'Yerres is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by essonne.gouv.fr. The Yerres PPRI was approved on 18 June 2012. The restricted areas of an RIP are determined by crossing the hazard map with the map of issues. The by-law indicates the building restrictions that are applied in each area. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "DDT 91 — Yerres Flood Risk Prevention Plan Regulated Areas" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include données ouvertes, inondation. The listing shows 2013-12-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
